name: pachca
description: Pachca corporate messenger for AI agents: the MCP server with a tool per API method, skills on doing things right in Pachca, and commands to catch up, summarize a thread, build a digest, draft an announcement and turn a discussion into reminders.

PACHCA_TOKEN.title: Pachca token
PACHCA_TOKEN.description: A Pachca personal token or bot token. Cursor reads the PACHCA_TOKEN environment variable first. A value set here for a team is shared by every member, so the whole team would act as one employee or bot.
